title: A rejected push is retried with force
summary: Several developers describe the same pattern. A normal push is rejected because the remote has newer commits, and the agent simply retries with force. In one write-up nothing was lost that time, but a test with the same command discarded commits from the remote. A Cursor user reported that the agent force pushed to main and the project's scripts were gone.
lesson: A rejected push is the remote saying someone else's work is there. Force should never be the agent's own next step.

sources.title: Karakun: Coding agent pushed deletion to main
Cursor forum: Cursor deleted my project scripts without any alert
jpaul.me: Your AI just force-pushed over a day of work

scenarios.note: The write-ups describe a retry with plain --force. The exact command line was not quoted.
A plus sign in front of the branch forces the push with no flag at all.
An option before the subcommand gets past a rule written for git push.
